component.name: Repadio
component.summary: Pure-Rust audio and video player on the Repose GUI framework

description.p: Repadio is a cross-platform audio and video player built as a reference example for the Repose GUI framework.

ul.li: Audio decoding via Symphonia (MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV, AAC, and more)
Video decoding via videoson (H.264, H.265, AV1)
Low-latency playback via CPAL
Embedded metadata and album art display
Playlist management with drag-to-reorder
Cross-platform: Linux, macOS, Windows, Web (WASM), Android
